preconditions.description: The number of days is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
The number of stores is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
The number of integers bought by Dora on any day is between 1 and n - 1, inclusive.
The indices of the stores where Dora bought an integer on any day are between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'possible' or 'impossible'.
